AERIS-10: Open Source Pulse Linear Frequency Modulated Phased Array Radar
 
     
 
AERIS-10 is an open-source, low-cost 10.5 GHz phased array radar system featuring Pulse Linear Frequency Modulated (LFM) modulation. items.title: Show HN: Kursal, a decentralized E2E encrypted messenger
items.contentSnippet:
I'm building Kursal for over a year now. All backend is built in Rust for speed and safety.
No central server and no accounts. Peers connect over libp2p [1] and messages go through a Double Ratchet + PQXDH (Signal's protocol), so it's resistant to quantum attacks too.
I experimented with decentralization and encryption, and described it all on a technical paper [2]
All open source, of course, and I'd love having feedback!
[1] https://libp2p.io
[2] https://kursal.chat/kursal.pdf

items.title: Show HN: Clx 0.4.0 – native compiler for Lua
items.contentSnippet:
clx is a native compiler that compiles Lua 5.5 scripts to standalone executables. Version 0.4.0 is out, focused on performance and stability :
- New generational garbage collector
- Faster function calls
- Faster table iteration using next(), pairs(), ipairs()
- Faster string operations using SIMD instructions on x64 and ARM64
- Optional dynamic execution of Lua code using an embedded Lua VM with seamless interoperability with native code
